base_source: QEMU 10.0.13 plus sealed native/qemu-task-preemption v1 patch (N18)

patch_dry_run.result: Both files applied cleanly to the sealed N18 source; no source files were written during the dry run.

scope: Extends opt-in x86 TCG real-8259 task preemption from direct master IRQs to real slave/cascade IRQs and nested real PIC interrupt frames. It retains the existing machine-global PIC/PIT and task-private RAM/fetch views.

qmp_api.outstanding_frame_receipt: Ordered outstanding-frames entries bind task identity, PIC ack sequence, native frame sequence, global IRQ/vector, master/slave lines, and required/seen EOI masks. Bit 0 is master EOI; bit 1 is slave EOI. The legacy inflight fields project the newest outstanding frame; ack-count minus eoi-count equals outstanding-count.
qmp_api.eoi_counters: ack-count counts every successfully framed real PIC IRQ while enabled. eoi-count increments once per frame after all required controller EOIs. Quantum progress advances only when the configured IRQ frame completes; preemption-count counts completed switches. A target handoff can remain pending while an older or nested frame is outstanding.
qmp_api.coalescing: The pending handoff is one boolean request, not a queue of switches. If more configured-IRQ quantum thresholds complete before the outstanding stack drains, they coalesce into the next eligible handoff; later completions continue advancing quantum-progress, and at most one switch occurs at the empty-stack boundary.

interrupt_contract.supported_pic: Normal dual-8259 mode with configured global IRQ 0..15 except cascade line 2; one TCG vCPU.
interrupt_contract.slave_irq_binding: A slave IRQ has one native hardware frame and records both master cascade line 2 and the source slave line. Its matching slave EOI must occur before the master IRQ2 EOI.
interrupt_contract.nested_ownership: All accepted real PIC IRQs are tracked while enabled, including non-policy nested IRQs. EOIs bind LIFO to the newest outstanding frame. A task switch is deferred until no outstanding controller EOI remains; fully EOI-complete frames remain task-owned until IRET.
interrupt_contract.checkpoint: fdisbull/task-private VMState advances to version 5. The nested frame VMState layout remains unchanged; API3 PIC bindings are stored in parallel arrays. Consistent nested and partially EOI-complete cascade states can be saved when PIC ISR bits exactly match the native frame stack. A stable pending target handoff is saveable only while another frame remains outstanding; a pending handoff with an empty stack is refused.
interrupt_contract.legacy_streams: The N18 version-4 direct-master binding is reconstructed as a one-controller frame. Versions 1..3 load with PIC preemption disabled and no inherited PIC-frame ownership metadata. Host exact-binary fencing means cross-binary checkpoint interchange is not qualified.

fails_closed: auto-EOI, PIC polling, PIC reinitialization, or unsupported PIC modes
mismatched, ambiguous, duplicate-line, or out-of-order EOI ownership
IRET before all EOIs required by its hardware frame
bounds.limits: The bounded native task scheduler, task count, private page cap, supported CPU modes, allocation identity, and device/DMA limitations remain those of the preceding qemu-task-scheduler patch. This does not implement a proprietary task manager or general DOS task scheduler. This delta adds no timer source; general IRQ timing remains unqualified beyond the prior bounded authored real IRQ0 witness, and this cascade change does not broaden that qualification.

build.initial_build_result: Full configure and initial 1587-step build/link succeeded.
build.incremental_build_result: After the policy handoff boundary fix, the task-private C object compiled and QEMU relinked in the final four-step incremental build; the frozen binary hash below matches the qualification run.
build.result: Configure, initial build, incremental handoff-fix build, and link succeeded. No build or guest execution was performed by the patch author.

native_qualification.owner: Root-owned; no guest execution by patch author.
scope: real RTC IRQ8 cascade delivery with matching slave and master EOIs

policy IRQ8 handoff after the cascade completes
policy IRQ1 handoff deferred until the outer IRQ8 cascade completes

master cascade EOI before slave EOI faults without task switch
previous N18 standard/virtual IRQ0, direct IRQ1, quantum, scheduler-frame, interrupt-shadow, and instrumented-checkpoint cases
